title: Borrel & GLOW Walk
summary: A free borrel, then a walk together through the GLOW light festival. Registration is mandatory.
description:
Drinks with fellow postdocs at De Zwarte Doos, then we head out together into GLOW, Eindhoven's festival of light.

The borrel is free, but registration is mandatory. [Flyer (PDF)](flyers/glow-walk-2026.pdf)

programme.item: Free borrel at De Zwarte Doos

title: Talking Science 2026
summary: Thirteen PhD, EngD and postdoc researchers pitch their own research in three minutes. Jury prizes of €750 and €500, plus a €500 audience prize. Organised by the TU/e Communication Expertise Center as part of WinTU/er Wonderland.
description:
TU/e pitch competition for PhD, EngD and postdoc researchers, followed by drinks. Organised by the TU/e Communication Expertise Center as part of WinTU/er Wonderland.

Thirteen researchers pitch their own research in three minutes. The jury awards prizes of €750 and €500, and the audience picks the winner of a €500 audience prize.

[Details on tue.nl](https://www.tue.nl/universiteit/calendar-and-events/11-12-2026-talking-science-2026)
